name: A Level Sociology: Verstane
subtitle: A Level Sociology labs, mocks
shortDescription: Learn A Level Sociology with live simulations, study cards, essay planners and adaptive quizzes for AQA and OCR. Free to start, optional Verstane Plus.
longDescription:
A Level Sociology revision for AQA and OCR students: Verstane is an independent study companion. It follows the AQA 7192 content areas and every OCR H580 option, and it adapts to what you get right and wrong.

### Learn
- 98 topics across 12 units: culture and identity, education, methods and theory, families, health, work and poverty, beliefs, global development, media, stratification, crime and deviance and youth subcultures.
- Every topic has a clear lesson, key terms, 499 study and thinker summaries with evaluation points, an exam tip and a real-world build task.
- Choose Syllabus order or Real-World order: start from a live question such as why some pupils fall behind, and pull in the theory and evidence you need.

### Practise
- 784 original questions, at least 8 for every topic, mixing recall, application and evaluation.
- Adaptive Today plan: fix recent slips, spaced review, then the next new topic, each with a reason.
- Check-ins, unit tests and a timed mock, with explanations and links back to the exact part of the lesson.

### Experiment
- Sampling lab, the dark figure of crime and the labelling loop, plus a theory lens that compares perspectives side by side.
- With Plus: social mobility machine, population pyramid, moral panic spiral, media effects explorer, essay plan builder and methods-in-context planner.

### Know What Is Covered
- A Coverage screen lists exactly which specification areas are included, and a curriculum map shows how units line up with GCSE Sociology and related IB study. Pearson does not offer an A Level in sociology, so the app does not cover one.
- Text size from 50% to 300%, built for iPhone and iPad.
whatsNew: Privacy fix. The words you type in search are no longer part of the optional usage information; they stay on your device, which now matches the text under the usage switch. Feedback and diagnostic reports are still sent only when you choose to send them.
monetization: Free core course, optional monthly Plus
